messages:
lucas: Heads-up — saw provisional credits stick after a canary rollback. Dashboard shows +2.3k provisional tokens for a session that was rolled back, looks like stream reconnect + toolcall retry path. Anyone seen this?

maria: Oh no. can you paste trace id / run id? which model and route?

lucas: trace=trc_0a9f3cb, route=chat.gen.v2, model=open-ggml-xl-fp16, logs:
```
2026-03-18T21:02:11Z INFO stream resumed session=ssn_7a1 toolcall=idempotency=null emitted=prefix_tokens=56
2026-03-18T21:02:13Z WARN toolcall retry triggered by client timeout, new toolcall id tc_992
2026-03-18T21:02:13Z INFO provisional_charge session=ssn_7a1 amount=2300
2026-03-18T21:02:15Z INFO rollback triggered by canary-rollback event, session closed
```

kirti: sounds like the classic: we charge provisional on every emitted token until a confirm event. rollback path currently doesn't clear provisional for sessions that were mid-toolcall + retried. truncation logic also leaves suffix tokens counted.

sam: Is the double-charge coming from the retry creating a separate provisional entry for the retry toolcall? Toolcalls are billed separately so we need to dedupe by original call context.

maria: Right — if client retries at the transport layer we may not have the original toolcall id (streaming client didn't attach idempotency key). Internal API debate: require server-assigned session/toolcall tokens vs client-provided idempotency for streaming.

lucas: For streaming, client-provided idempotency is tough (mobile SDKs). Proposal: server-side "retry-window" dedupe: if a new toolcall arrives within Xs of a session's last toolcall and shares same prefix hash, treat as same for provisional ledger.

kirti: That could work. Need to be careful with memory blowup if X large. Also we should ensure truncation events emit a `truncation_marker` so replayed streams don't re-count trimmed suffix.

billing-bot: Created billing incident INC-1234 linking dashboard alert and trace trc_0a9f3cb :eyes:

devex: Console ask: can we surface provisional vs confirmed amounts per session and link straight to trace / logs? Users keep getting confused when provisional lingers after a rollback. Hover tooltip + trace deep-link would help.

kirti: Quick patch idea: on rollback event subtract known provisional for session from provisional ledger and emit a reconcile telemetry event: `{reconcile: true, reason: 'rollback', session}`. I'll PR a safe path that only touches provisional entries not finalized charges.

lucas: Test plan: unit tests for early-eof + mid-toolcall retry, integration test simulating reconnect + canary rollback; telemetry tags to add: `provisional=true`, `rollback=true`, `toolcall_retry=true`. Also add an assert that final confirmed_charge == sum(emitted_tokens_confirmed) and provisional cleared.

sam: +1. also add a console flag to show provisional-only rows so CS can triage faster. :thumbsup:

maria: Also log the prefix hash in debug mode so router can dedupe without client changes. That should avoid forcing idempotency keys on all streaming clients.

lucas: OK I'll coordinate the PR with kirti, we'll include a short migration note for any existing provisional reconciles. Thanks all.
